scope: Read-only independent review of frozen client run/iteration state, initialization, four ordered phases, generic portable pipeline and typed control outcomes.
result: No introduced control-flow or cross-run state defect identified. One silent observer-health defect found and corrected by owning agent. Final rebuilt global test gate remains required.

findings.problem: Initial pipeline swallowed observer exceptions without any failure count or health event.
findings.fix: Per-run AgentIterationObserverHealth uses Interlocked counter, passed explicitly to pipeline; runner finally emits collector_health. Probe iteration uses lifecycle.Iteration after budget retry decrements turn.

casesReviewed: Continue short-circuits phases and preserves the outer increment and inherited retry turn--.
Stop exits the pipeline, then the switch and outer loop, reaching the existing safe-result builder.
Complete requires a non-null result, skips remaining phases and returns the exact result.
Rewriter converts only exits targeting the original outer loop; nearest inner loop/switch and lambda/local-function exits remain local.
Run state is allocated within each RunCore call; iteration state is freshly allocated per turn. No new execution state is stored on reusable runner.
Existing candidate/evidence/selection/budget gate inputs and instruction order are preserved; extraction adds no semantic decision by code.
Caller token still reaches stages. Pipeline records caller cancellation, then rethrows; outer lifecycle records failed/cancelled outcome.
Telemetry scope still covers initialization and all turns; terminal-review budget scope stays within its semantic-review block.

staticPreservation.limitation: Implementing agent supplied the static transformation proof. Reviewer checked its target-detection algorithm and actual output hashes independently. This does not establish model semantic quality.

behavioralEvidence.profileRegression: New PG parsing initially rejected valid local Host strings because PowerShell adapted .ConnectionString assignment as a dictionary entry. Corrected with CLR setter/getter and positive tests matching the isolated fixture plus quoted values; duplicate/alias/multi-host counterexamples are rejected.

testContractChanges.limitation: Architecture guards do not replace execution of every branch end to end.
testContractChanges.method: Compiled calls/literals and typed Outcome.Stop replace stale source path and exact whitespace.

residualDebt: Four phases remain private methods on the same runner; substantial documentary policies have not become independent domain services.
State ownership is explicit, but the per-run state is broad: 80 lifted run locals and 25 iteration locals, plus its root identifiers/lifecycle.
Native routing now has real portable reader/wire-identifier owners and separate pure prompt/tool-catalog owners, with no compatibility facade left only for old tests.
Physical size ceilings and successful extraction alone do not close all of A03 or establish perfection.
Normal installed-binary success/error/cancel/resume smoke and paid semantic acceptance remain separate unexecuted gates.
